disposition: Direct visual review complete with explicit capture limitations

reviewMethod.attribution: The independent reviewer directly viewed all 51 original paths across this review continuation, including both same-byte host lobby images. Counts do not substitute collector statements or byte matches for a direct view.
reviewMethod.display: The image tool displayed the original files using its default view rendering. This is substantive visible-content review, not an automated image comparison or exhaustive accessibility audit.
reviewMethod.integrity: Original manifest/member hashes were independently checked in the pinned dedicated result receipt. This sealing script copies those verified references and checks receipt consistency; it does not rehash the PNGs, ZIP, job log or source tree.
reviewMethod.scriptRole: Serializes manually supplied visual findings and verifies their exact membership/pointers. Rerunning this script does not repeat the visual inspection.

originalRetention: Canonical paths refer to the newly collected originals. Earlier temporary originals were deleted during the restart; this review does not attribute them as surviving.
ordering: Production entries follow the independent result receipt chronology; manifest case/attachment/label-occurrence ordinals remain original manifest order, which is reverse chronological. Ordinary entries retain owner manifest order.

standard_concealed.basis: Direct view of each named original PNG by the independent reviewer

visualLimitations.finding: The immediate accepted NEXT_ROUND capture still displays the preceding result panel, not round 2.
visualLimitations.acceptedStateEvidence: Its paired sanitized accepted COMPOSE NEXT_ROUND receipt independently records round 2; dedicated-native-results-independent-review-v1.json establishes acceptance.
visualLimitations.laterVisualFinding: The later 2D Leave-cancel capture visibly shows ROUND 2 with a concealed hand and no dialog.
visualLimitations.scope: A limitation of the immediate visual evidence. It does not negate the accepted authority action and does not establish a persistent rendering defect.

visualLimitations.finding: The source takes a screenshot and then attaches the latest sanitized lastDocument. Exact case, source label and close timestamps bind the exported evidence sequence, not an atomic rendered frame and authority state.
visualLimitations.scope: Do not claim that every capture is a pixel-exact realization of its paired observation.

visualLimitations.finding: Initial unscrolled 3D frames clip the bottom Return to lobby action. The actual post-scroll image shows all three full action buttons and retained selection.
visualLimitations.scope: Whole-button coverage is accepted for the actual post-scroll checkpoint. Challenge action execution is not claimed.

visualLimitations.finding: Native 2D selections show part of a horizontal hand strip. All five 2D native cards are not simultaneously visible in these captures.
The ordinary Settings credits link and practice result next action are partly clipped in their captured scrolling viewports.
